args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt, AVG(o.amount) as avg_cents FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'enterprise'

transcript.text: The average order amount across all orders (all statuses) placed by enterprise-tier customers is 161456.77 cents, which converts to USD.

args.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.amount)/100.0, 2) as avg_usd FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'enterprise'

transcript.text:
I joined `memory.bench.orders` to `memory.bench.customers` (filtering `tier = 'enterprise'`), computed the average of the `amount` column (287 orders, avg 161,456.77 cents), and converted from US cents to USD per the catalog's documented convention (amounts stored as integers in cents; divide by 100).

FINAL ANSWER: 1614.57
